description: Align (mode align) or distribute (mode distribute) several objects on one spread like the Align panel (Ausrichten): edge left, horizontal_center, right, top, vertical_center, bottom – for distribute also horizontal_space and vertical_space (equal gaps; with spacing_mm a fixed gap). relative_to selection (default: the objects' common bounds), key_object (with key_frame_id, the key stays put), margins, page or spread. Groups move as a whole; members of a group, objects on other spreads and locked layers are refused. Returns objects[] {frame_id, bounds_mm} after, before, moved_count (warning when nothing moved). All coordinates are page millimetres of the page each object lands on.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

edge.description: Which edges or centres; *_space only for distribute.

frame_ids.description: Objects to align or distribute (2 or more; 1 is enough when aligning to margins, page or spread).

key_frame_id.description: relative_to key_object: the object that stays in place (one of frame_ids).

spacing_mm.description: distribute: fixed distance in mm instead of equal distribution.

name: align_objects
title: Align or distribute objects
